event_summary: A surfer on a surfboard rides along a breaking ocean wave and becomes hidden by curling water and whitewater.
raw_event_description: The video begins with a person in a dark full-body suit standing on a light-colored surfboard on the face of a breaking ocean wave. The person moves along the wave while changing stance from more upright to crouched. The board rises near the crest, and fan-shaped spray appears behind the rider. The wave face steepens and curls, with whitewater expanding on the rider's right side. The rider then lowers into the darker wave face near the breaking section, becomes partially obscured by spray and foam, and later is no longer visible while parts of the surfboard intermittently appear under or beside the curling water.

reasons: The surfer and surfboard are already on the wave at the first visible moment.
The wave face, crest, foam, and surrounding ocean surface are visible.
The beginning of the ride before the first frame is not shown.

The front of the surfboard lifts above the crest line while the surfer bends the knees.
A fan-shaped spray of white water rises behind the surfer.
The surfer descends lower on the wave face with a crouched posture.
The dark wave face forms an overhanging curling section to the surfer's left.
Whitewater expands around the surfer's right side.
The surfer becomes partially hidden by spray and foam.
Only part of the surfer's upper body remains visible near the breaking whitewater.
The surfer is no longer visible under the curling wave section and foam.

White foamy water fills much of the foreground throughout the clip.
The horizon and background ocean remain in a wide fixed view.
